cues.en: Hello everyone and welcome to the linear regression project exercise overview lecture.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到線性迴歸專案練習概覽。

cues.en: In this lecture we're going to get a brief overview and background for the project exorcized notebook concerning the linear regression project.
cues.zh: 本堂簡介線性迴歸專案練習筆記本，以及專案背景。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and jump to the notebook now.
cues.zh: 現在切到筆記本。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Here I am at the notebook as a quick note you can find this linear regression project exorcized notebook under the machine learning sections linear regression folder.
cues.zh: 現在在筆記本。提醒一下，這份練習在 Machine Learning Sections 的 Linear Regression 資料夾。

cues.en: You'll notice that there's two notebooks here.
cues.zh: 裡面有兩份筆記本。

cues.en: Linear Regression Dasch practic project exercise and linear regression Dasch project exercise solutions .
cues.zh: Linear Regression - Project Exercise，以及 Linear Regression - Project Exercise Solutions。

cues.en: Go ahead and attempt the exercise before checking out the solutions which will have all the code fill them and then you'll also notice an e-commerce customers file.
cues.zh: 先嘗試練習，再看已填好全部程式碼的解答。另外有 Ecommerce Customers 檔。

cues.en: That's going to be the source of our data for this project exercise.
cues.zh: 就是這個專案的資料來源。

cues.en: OK let me go ahead and give you some background for this project.
cues.zh: 好，介紹背景。

cues.en: You just got some contract work with an e-commerce company based in New York City that sells clothing online but the store also has in-store style and clothing advice sessions.
cues.zh: 你剛接到紐約市一家電子商務公司的合約工作，這家公司在線上賣衣服，也有實體店的穿搭與服裝諮詢。

cues.en: Customers can come into the store have sessions or meetings if a personal stylist and then they can go home and order either through immobile app or web site for the Kloves they want.
cues.zh: 顧客能到店與個人造型師諮詢，再回家透過手機 App 或網站，訂購想要的衣服。

cues.en: The company is trying to decide whether to focus their efforts on their mobile apps experience or on their Web site experience.
cues.zh: 公司正決定該專注手機 App 體驗，還是網站體驗。

cues.en: And they've hired you on contract to help them figure it out and then you can go ahead and get started by just analyzing the customer data.
cues.zh: 所以聘你協助判斷。可以先分析顧客資料。

cues.en: And another quick note we're going to be dealing with some artificially generated data.
cues.zh: 另外提醒，這是人工產生的資料。

cues.en: It has credit card numbers and emails.
cues.zh: 有信用卡號與電子郵件。

cues.en: But don't worry none of those are real.
cues.zh: 但不用擔心，全都不是真的。

cues.en: You'll go ahead and just follow along that you've done for other exercises of the imports.
cues.zh: 和其他練習一樣，先匯入，

cues.en: Getting the data and just following the instructions written in bold you should keep in mind that you may want to insert cells if you don't want to overwrite the current output.
cues.zh: 取得資料，再依粗體說明操作。記得如果不想覆寫目前輸出，可以插入儲存格。

cues.en: Then you'll also do some exploratory data analysis with seaborne creating some of these visualizations and diagrams trying to understand the data and you'll answer some questions about the data.
cues.zh: 接著用 seaborn 做探索分析，建立這些視覺化圖形，理解資料，回答一些問題。

cues.en: Then you will create training and testing sets for your data.
cues.zh: 再替資料建立訓練與測試集。

cues.en: You'll train a model and you'll predict based off of your test data then you'll evaluate your model and also look at the residuals and you'll have a conclusion.
cues.zh: 訓練模型，根據測試資料預測，評估模型、查看殘差，再下結論。

cues.en: OK best of luck on the project exercise and coming up next is a walk through solution of all the code of explanations.
cues.zh: 好，祝專案順利。下一堂逐步講解全部程式碼與解釋。

cues.en: Thanks everyone and I hope you enjoyed the project.
cues.zh: 謝謝大家，希望你喜歡這個專案。
